f3_program: observe(at("fiscal_2017_restructuring_plan.balance_payable.total", "june_30_2019"), 3995, "currency", cell("Balance payable as at June 30, 2019", "Total"))
observe(at("fiscal_2017_restructuring_plan.balance_payable.total", "june_30_2017"), 11414, "currency", cell("Balance payable as at June 30, 2017", "Total"))
query("absolute_difference", at("fiscal_2017_restructuring_plan.balance_payable.total", "june_30_2019"), at("fiscal_2017_restructuring_plan.balance_payable.total", "june_30_2017"))
remove("forfeiture_2017", "company", at("company.rsus_prsus_outstanding.nonvested_shares", "current"), 19, cell("Forfeited", "Number of Shares"))
remove("forfeiture_2019", "company", at("company.rsus_prsus_outstanding.nonvested_shares", "current"), 41, cell("Forfeited", "Number of Shares"))
query("mean", event_field("forfeiture_2017", "quantity"), event_field("forfeiture_2019", "quantity"))
collection("three_boys.stamps", "stamp", "three_boys", source("CJ, KJ, and AJ collect stamps"))
member("three_boys.stamps", "cj.stamps", source("CJ, KJ, and AJ collect stamps"))
member("three_boys.stamps", "kj.stamps", source("CJ, KJ, and AJ collect stamps"))
member("three_boys.stamps", "aj.stamps", source("CJ, KJ, and AJ collect stamps"))
multiple(at("kj.stamps.twice_count", "current"), at("kj.stamps.count", "current"), 2, source("CJ has 5 more than twice the number of stamps that KJ has"))
offset(at("cj.stamps.count", "current"), at("kj.stamps.twice_count", "current"), 5, "count", source("CJ has 5 more than twice the number of stamps that KJ has"))
fraction_of(at("kj.stamps.count", "current"), at("aj.stamps.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("KJ has half as many as AJ"))
observe(at("three_boys.stamps.count", "current"), 930, "count", source("the three boys have 930 stamps all together"))

sum_relation(at("three_boys.stamps.count", "current"), at("cj.stamps.count", "current"), at("kj.stamps.count", "current"), at("aj.stamps.count", "current"), source("the three boys have 930 stamps all together"))
query("value", at("aj.stamps.count", "current"))
collection("magdalena.apple_tree.apples", "apple", "magdalena.apple_tree", source("it grew 200 apples"))
observe(at("magdalena.apple_tree.apples.count", "initial"), 200, "count", source("it grew 200 apples"))

remove("first_day_pick", "magdalena", at("magdalena.apple_tree.apples.count", "current"), fraction(at("magdalena.apple_tree.apples.count", "initial"), 1, 5), source("Magdalena picked 1/5 of the fruits on the first day"))
remove("second_day_pick", "magdalena", at("magdalena.apple_tree.apples.count", "current"), scale(event_field("first_day_pick", "quantity"), 2), source("twice that number on the second day"))

offset(at("magdalena.apple_tree.apples.picked.third_day.count", "third_day"), event_field("first_day_pick", "quantity"), 20, "count", source("20 more apples than he picked on the first day on the third day"))

remove("third_day_pick", "magdalena", at("magdalena.apple_tree.apples.count", "current"), at("magdalena.apple_tree.apples.picked.third_day.count", "third_day"), source("20 more apples than he picked on the first day on the third day"))
query("remaining_count", "magdalena.apple_tree.apples", "current")
